paite: Khau dum leh khau sandup leh khau san-au kigan in Mun Siangthou a nasepna ding siampu puante abawl ua, Aaron puansilh siangthoute abawl uhi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang a bawl ahi.
heading: Siampute A Ding Puan Bawlna / (Eks 28.1-14)
english: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah dangka-eng in siampu puan abawl uhi.
english: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

paite: Dangka-eng khau leh khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih a kigan in siampu puanakzem abawl uhi.
english: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.

paite: Anunglam leh malam kaihkhawmna ding, aliangzang ah kaihna abawl ua, atunglam gei tuak akhihkhawm hi.
english: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.

paite: Atung a om, asiampu puanak siamneltak a gat leng akibang mah in anasep dungzui in; dangka-eng, khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak dungzui in gat in abawl uhi.
english: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Onik suang abawl ua, chiamtehna gelhna a gelh, dangka- eng bulhna a bulh in, Israel suante min dungzui zel in abawl uhi.
english: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

paite: Huaite siampu puanak liangzang ah akoih ua, Israel suante a dia theihgigena suangte hi ding in: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl hi.
english: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Khutsiamtak in awmtuam abawl a, siampu puan bawl bang in, dangka-eng, khau dum leh khau san leh khau sandup leh khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in abawl hi.
heading: Awmtuamna Bawlna / (Eks 28.15-30)
english: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

paite: Adung-avai akikim a; awmtuamna thuah nih in abawl uhi. Asau lam khap khat ahi a, availam khap khat, thuah nih ahi.
english: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.

paite: Huai ah vual li in suang asiat ua; avual khatna sardi suang, topaz suang leh karbankul suang; hiai avual khatna ahi.
english: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;

paite: Avual nihna, emerald suang, sapphir suang leh diamond ahi.
english: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

paite: Avual thumna, liguri suang, agate suang leh amethis suang ahi.
english: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

paite: Avual lina, beril suang, onik suang leh jasper suang ahi a; aphuhna uah dangka-eng bulhna asiatlut uhi.
english: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.

paite: Suangte Israel suante min dungzui zel leh ahihna zah uh dungzui zel in, sawm-le-nih, chiamtehna gelhnate bang in, michih amin toh nam sawm-le-nihte gelh ahi.
english: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

paite: Amongte ah awmtuam tung ah khainiang, dangka-engtak pakkhi abawl uhi.
english: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

paite: Huchi in dangka-eng bulhna nih abawl ua, dangka-eng sikkual nih toh, awmtuamna mong nihte ah sikkual nihte akoih uhi.
english: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

paite: Awmtuamna mongte a sikkual nihte sung ah dangka-eng khainiang nihte pak bang a bawl in athun uhi.
english: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

paite: Pak khainiang nihte mong nihte suangmantam bulhna nihte ah akoih ua, ama ah siampu puan liangzang thuahna ah akoih uhi.
english: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.

paite: Dangka-eng in sikkual nih abawl ua, awmtuamna mong nihte tung ah akoih ua, agei ah sunglam pang ah siampu puanak a-om hi.
english: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

paite: Dangka-eng sikkual nih dang abawl ua, nuailam ah siampu puanak mong nihte ah akoih uhi, amalam sang ah, akikhepna zawntak ah, siampu puanak kawnggak kigatthoh tung ah akoih uhi.
english: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

paite: Gakna khau dum in siampu puanak sikkualte in awmtuam agakden ua, siampu puanak a pan a awmtuam akiphel theihlouhna ding in; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl uhi.
english: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Siampu puanak puanaktual gatthoh, avek a adum a bawl ahi.
heading: Siampu Kivatna Van Dangte Bawlna / (Eks 28.1-43)
english: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

paite: Puanak tual laitak ah avang a-om a, sik puanak banbei vang bang in, akeklouhna ding a, avang kimvel in kaihna khau a-om hi.
english: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.

paite: Puanak tual mongte ah khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih in theibuhfai gahte abawl uhi.
english: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.

paite: Dangka-engtak in dak abawl ua, dakte puanaktual mong a theibuhfai gahte kikal ah, theibuhfai gahte kikal zel ah akhaisuak uhi. 26 Dak leh theibuhfai akhaisuak uhi.
english: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;

paite: Dak leh theibuhfai gahte nasepna ding a puanaktual mong kimvel ah TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl uhi.
english: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Aaron leh atapate a ding in puanmalngat puanak tung gatthoh abawl uhi.
english: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,

paite: Puanmalngat hoih in lukhu leh puanmalngat hoih in lutuam leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in puan pheituam gek abawl uhi.
english: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,

paite: Kawnggak puanmalngat hoih koptah, khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in khuithoh in abawl uhi.
english: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Dangka-engtak in lallukhu siangthou abawl ua, atung ah laigelh, chiamtehna gelhnate bang in, SIANTHOUNA TOUPA A AHI chih agelh uhi.
english: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO YAHWEH”.

paite: Huai ah khauhual dum akhih ua, lukhu tunglam gaktou pek ding in; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl uhi.
english: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Hichibang in khawmpite' kihoupihna biakbuk nasep tengteng zoh ahita hi. TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a thupiak bang in Israel suante'n ahihta uhi.
heading: Nasep Zohna / (Eks 35.10-19)
english: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses; so they did.

paite: Biakbuk leh puanin van tengteng, akibatnate, asingpekte, azawlte, akhuamte leh kingakna khuakkuakte Mosi kiang ah hon tawi uhi.
english: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

paite: Akhuhna belampa vun diahsan leh akhuhna ngalvang vun leh akhuhna puanzak;
english: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,

paite: theihpihna bawm leh azawlte leh zahngaihna tutphah;
english: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,

paite: dohkan leh atui-um belsuan tengteng leh Pathian Ompihna tanghou sawm-le-nihte;
english: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,

paite: khawnvak koihna, khawnvakte leh atui-um belsuan tengteng leh khawnvak a dia sathau;
english: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,

paite: dangka-eng maitam leh nilh theih sathau leh gimlim leh puanin kong a ding a puankhai;
english: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,

paite: dal maitam, adal hakvang, azawlte leh atui-um belsuan tengteng tuikuang leh akhe;
english: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,

paite: huangsung puankhaite, akhuamte leh akingakna khuakkuakte leh huangsung kongpi puankhai, akhaute, akilhna zumte leh biakbuk nasepna tui-um belsuan tengteng, kihoupihna biakbuk a ding:
english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,

paite: Mun siangthou a nasepna ding nasepna puan, hoihtak a bawlte, siampu Aaron a ding puan siangthoute leh atapate puante, siampu nasepna mun a nasepna ding,
english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in, huchibang in Israel suante'n nna tengteng asem uhi.
english: According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

paite: Mosi in nasep tengteng a-en a, ngai in TOUPA thupiak bangtak in asemkheta uhi. Huchi in Mosi in huaite avualzawl hi.
english: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.
